analysis: Exploratory aggregate analyses of paired predictions; no new model inference.
caveats: Fresh A43 uses seed-42 T1: no fresh seed-43 T1 run is available.
Fresh labels are the auditor-agreed reference, with unresolved queries excluded from quality.
Overlap is descriptive and does not establish a causal mechanism or deployment reliability.
Recovery enrichment conditions on fixed rescue-set marginals; its exact upper-tail p-values are exploratory and unadjusted.
Archived confidence intervals condition on fixed checkpoints and reference labels.
Benchmark PROD is the managed incumbent; fresh R120 is a local low-effort reference.

enrichment_vs_thinking.null_model: Uniform variant rescue subset of baseline misses, conditional on fixed rescue-set sizes
enrichment_vs_thinking.alternative: Overlap at least as large as observed (one-sided hypergeometric upper tail)
enrichment_vs_thinking.interpretation: Post hoc association diagnostic; unadjusted across comparisons; not evidence of a causal mechanism

common_workload_serving.method: 3600 * concurrency / mean request seconds, assuming all worker slots are busy; includes errored requests

fallback_serving_proxies.caveat: Arithmetic proxies, not measured staged throughput or GPU service cost. Assumes all 16 request slots remain occupied; archived request latency may include queueing and retries. End-to-end batching, queueing, and mixed-mode execution have not been measured.

archived_average_rate_proxy.assumption: Every routed query takes the archived average thinking request time
